newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest direct hogs trade steady - private.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest direct hogs trade steady - private.

text.p: Midwest direct cash hogs traded steady in most markets Tuesday and dealers said the flow of hogs to market generally was enough to satisfy demand.

Interior Iowa and Minnesota sources reported steady trades of $54.50 per cwt at country points and $55.50 at packing plants. An extreme top of $56.00 was paid Monday, and Iowa sources said that may occur again Tuesday.
It was snowing in Iowa but as of Tuesday morning the snowfall was not enough to seriously impede hog marketings, dealers said.
Illinois sources reported steady trades at $53.00 to $54.00 at country points and $55.00 to $55.50 on hogs delivered to packing plants.

Indiana hogs sold steady from $52.50 to $53.00 at country points and $53.50 to $54.00 at plants. The $53.50 to $54.00 would be steady with the bulk of sales Monday. An extreme top of $54.50 was reported Monday.
Ohio sources expect trade at steady values but prices were unavailable early Tuesday.
